purpose: Reconciliation audit of country colors, city entries and retained parcel evidence. This is an inventory audit with targeted source rechecks, not a fresh exhaustive search of every country.
rootCauses: Serbia had a live Belgrade database import but no corresponding verified source in the research registry; country classification therefore followed an older failed public-service check.
Croatia had verified geometry but its official national-scope evidence had not been entered in the new strict full-coverage review list.

Country research, city research, configured app cities and imported database sources are maintained separately. The prior tests accepted their recorded inputs and did not test that positive evidence had been reconciled.

corrections.basis: LINZ explicit national primary land-parcel scope and retained native-ID geometry samples.
SLA explicit entire surveyed-land-lot cadastre and retained native-ID geometry samples.

corrections.after: verified city and live app entry
corrections.basis: Official active-cadastre ArcGIS adapter: complete 27-feature area query and exact KAEK read.
Anonymous MSDA point and exact-code queries return native cadastral code and WGS84 polygon; complete area query remains unverified.

interpretation: Yellow confirms some parcel geometry. It does not imply an app adapter or even a city record: national research samples were not expanded into named city entries. Small territories omitted by the coarse outline source remain a separate geography gap.
